```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

Cleaning and tidying the dataset. 
```{r include=FALSE}
ny_noaa_df = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    day = day(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  )
```
